audit_items.proof_trace: The flash loan functions (borrow_flash_loan, repay_flash_loan) are completely decoupled from XOracle — they neither read nor write oracle state. Oracle prices can only change via the separate permissionless refresh_usd_price function, which any caller may invoke independently of any flash loan. Obligation safety checks use get_price_with_check (market.move:1284), which enforces EMA prices and aborts if EMA/spot diverge beyond per-asset tolerance, providing robust resistance to price manipulation even if an extreme attestation is submitted in the same PTB.
